audit_phase: Phase 3.1: Independent Competitive Intelligence Audit & Research Integrity

key_audit_discoveries_and_corrections.finding: FINDING-001 Blinkit Throughput Calculation Numerator Contamination
key_audit_discoveries_and_corrections.description: Prior draft plugged in Swiggy Instamart GOV (₹2,724 Cr and ₹9,230 Cr) as Blinkit numerator, claiming a -20% contraction. Audited calculation using Blinkit true disclosed NOV (₹4,061 Cr to ₹20,940 Cr) proves throughput expanded +22.1% (₹6.96L to ₹8.50L / store-day).
key_audit_discoveries_and_corrections.action_taken: Corrected competitive findings engine, documentation, and reporting artifacts.

key_audit_discoveries_and_corrections.finding: FINDING-003 Food Delivery Net Take Rate Parity Claim
key_audit_discoveries_and_corrections.description: Claim of ~100 bps net merchant commission spread was an analyst hypothesis lacking unbundled customer voucher and loyalty accounting disclosure.
key_audit_discoveries_and_corrections.action_taken: Reclassified from Derived Fact to Analyst Hypothesis, and downgraded to Level 3 Directionally Comparable.

key_audit_discoveries_and_corrections.finding: FINDING-004 Instamart Margin vs AOV Contemporaneous Causality
key_audit_discoveries_and_corrections.description: Quarter-on-quarter jumps in AOV do not statistically cause same-quarter margin jumps (r=0.14, p=0.72).
key_audit_discoveries_and_corrections.action_taken: Preserved caution that margin expansion compounds gradually from density and route optimization.
